ns2:section.sectionText: Synthetic Nanomaterials. Meets with CHBE 494HY2. This course is focused on introducing the concepts related to the fundamentals and practical methods for the preparation of nanostructured materials. Classical nucleation and growth, interfacial science, crystal structures, and characterization techniques are among some of the topics covered. The emphasis will be placed on the synthesis of nanostructures in solution with the processing controls of size, shape (dot, wire, and two-dimensional materials), facet, composition, and hierarchical structure. Students will also be exposed to related current topics, including the applications of well-defined nanoparticles in energy, sustainability, and biotechnology.
